title: A chain approaches stationarity
hook: Two stated cases: explore the exact two-state total-variation distance.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the exact two-state total-variation distance affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines TV, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the exact two-state total-variation distance in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
